summary: Re-recorded with an incremental-write objective after three Codex runs died at the machine's ~10-min background-kill boundary having investigated the findings but batched the verdicts into a final write that never landed. Now each verdict is appended the instant it is made, and re-delegation resumes from the doc, skipping already-verdicted items.
gaps: Codex runs die at ~10min on this machine; a full 12-item verify exceeds that.
Batched final writes lose all progress on death.
A resumed run must not re-verify items already verdicted.
resolutions: Objective mandates one edit per item, appended immediately, so partial progress is durable.
write_scope is docs/architecture/audits only; verdicts land in the committed doc.
Objective tells the agent to skip items that already carry a verdict, so re-delegation resumes cleanly.
